population.eligibility.value: All category-year groups with wholesale quotations and sales in data; quoted SKU rates included once

basis.rationale: No procurement or inventory data; reporting estimated financial model over available observations

value: Net signed sales quantity (returns already negative); exact same date/item quote; no duplicate quotes; include all categories

basis.rationale: Return signs and exact quote coverage observed; no restriction requested

value.description: Simple wholesale quotation average/max/min and max-min difference. Total wholesale price interpreted net quantity times exact daily wholesale unit price; total selling price net quantity times actual selling unit price. Average loss rate simple mean across distinct quoted items per year. Loss estimated as net quantity*wholesale*r/(1-r) for procurement loss rate r; profit=revenue-sold-unit-cost-loss.

basis.rationale: Financial totals and loss denominator undefined; actual procurement unknown. This is disclosed estimate, not accounting fact.

measure.countGrain.value: Quotes for price mean; distinct quoted items for loss rate mean; transaction rows for revenue and cost

measure.denominator.value: Count of wholesale quotations for average price; distinct quoted items for average loss rate; 1-r for estimated procurement cost

candidates.sql: WITH wstats AS (SELECT substr(w.whsle_date,1,4) year,c.category_code,c.category_name,AVG(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]) avg_wholesale_price,MAX(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]) max_wholesale_price,MIN(w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]) min_wholesale_price FROM veg_whsle_df w JOIN veg_cat c USING(item_code) WHERE w.whsle_date>='2020-01-01' AND w.whsle_date<'2024-01-01' GROUP BY year,c.category_code,c.category_name), itemyear AS (SELECT DISTINCT substr(whsle_date,1,4) year,item_code FROM veg_whsle_df WHERE whsle_date>='2020-01-01' AND whsle_date<'2024-01-01'), rates AS (SELECT i.year,c.category_code,AVG(l.[loss_rate_%]) avg_loss_rate FROM itemyear i JOIN veg_cat c USING(item_code) JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l USING(item_code) GROUP BY i.year,c.category_code), financial AS (SELECT substr(t.txn_date,1,4) year,c.category_code,SUM(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]) total_wholesale_price,SUM(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]) total_selling_price,SUM(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg]*l.[loss_rate_%]/(100.0-l.[loss_rate_%])) total_loss FROM veg_txn_df t JOIN veg_whsle_df w ON t.item_code=w.item_code AND t.txn_date=w.whsle_date JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code=c.item_code JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON t.item_code=l.item_code WHERE t.txn_date>='2020-01-01' AND t.txn_date<'2024-01-01' GROUP BY year,c.category_code) SELECT w.year,w.category_name,ROUND(avg_wholesale_price,2) avg_wholesale_price,ROUND(max_wholesale_price,2) max_wholesale_price,ROUND(min_wholesale_price,2) min_wholesale_price,ROUND(max_wholesale_price-min_wholesale_price,2) wholesale_price_difference,ROUND(total_wholesale_price,2) total_wholesale_price,ROUND(total_selling_price,2) total_selling_price,ROUND(avg_loss_rate,2) avg_loss_rate,ROUND(total_loss,2) total_loss,ROUND(total_selling_price-total_wholesale_price-total_loss,2) profit FROM wstats w JOIN rates r USING(year,category_code) JOIN financial f USING(year,category_code) ORDER BY w.year,w.category_name
